items.source: beanClass - the class of the bean to instantiate
items.translation: beanClass - 要实例化的 Bean 的类

items.source:
Create a new RootBeanDefinition for a singleton,
providing constructor arguments and property values.
items.translation: 为单例创建一个新的 RootBeanDefinition，并提供构造函数参数和属性值。

items.source: Takes a bean class name to avoid eager loading of the bean class.
items.translation: 接受一个 Bean 类名以避免急切加载该 Bean 类。

items.source: Return a ResolvableType for this bean definition, either from runtime-cached type information or from configuration-time setTargetType(ResolvableType) or AbstractBeanDefinition.setBeanClass(Class), also considering resolved factory method definitions.
items.translation: 为此 Bean 定义返回一个ResolvableType，该类型信息可来自运行时缓存的类型信息，或来自配置时间的setTargetType(ResolvableType)或AbstractBeanDefinition.setBeanClass(Class)，同时也考虑已解析的工厂方法定义。

items.source: as of 6.0.11, in favor of an extra setTargetType(ResolvableType) call
items.translation: 自 6.0.11 版本起，更倾向于使用额外的setTargetType(ResolvableType)调用。

items.source: Create a new RootBeanDefinition for a singleton.
items.translation: 为单例创建一个新的 RootBeanDefinition。

items.source: instanceSupplier - the supplier to construct a bean instance, as an alternative to a declaratively specified factory method
items.translation: instanceSupplier - 用于构建 Bean 实例的供应者，作为声明式指定工厂方法的替代方案。

items.source: Root bean definitions may also be used for registering individual bean definitions in the configuration phase. This is particularly applicable for programmatic definitions derived from factory methods (for example, @Bean methods) and instance suppliers (for example, lambda expressions) which come with extra type metadata (see setTargetType(ResolvableType)/setResolvedFactoryMethod(Method)).
items.translation: 根 Bean 定义也可用于在配置阶段注册单个 Bean 定义。这对于源自工厂方法的程序化定义（例如，`@Bean` 方法）和实例供应者（例如，Lambda 表达式）尤其适用，这些定义附带额外的类型元数据（参见 setTargetType(ResolvableType)/setResolvedFactoryMethod(Method)）。

items.source: The supplied initMethod may be a simple method name or a qualified method name for package-private and private methods. A qualified name is necessary for package-private and private methods in order to disambiguate between multiple such methods with the same name within a type hierarchy.
items.translation: 提供的 `initMethod` 可能是一个 简单方法名，或者对于包级私有和 `private` 方法是一个 限定方法名。 对于包级私有和 `private` 方法，需要限定名称以便在类型层次结构中区分具有相同名称的多个此类方法。

items.source: The supplied destroyMethod may be the simple method name for non-private methods or the qualified method name for private methods. A qualified name is necessary for private methods in order to disambiguate between multiple private methods with the same name within a class hierarchy.
items.translation: 提供的 `destroyMethod` 可能是非私有方法的简单方法名，或者是 `private` 方法的限定方法名。对于 `private` 方法，需要限定名称以便在类层次结构中区分多个同名私有方法。

items.source: As of 6.1, the default implementation of this method takes the AbstractBeanDefinition.PREFERRED_CONSTRUCTORS_ATTRIBUTE attribute into account. Subclasses are encouraged to preserve this through a super call, either before or after their own preferred constructor determination.
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，此方法的默认实现会考虑AbstractBeanDefinition.PREFERRED_CONSTRUCTORS_ATTRIBUTE属性。子类应通过super调用保留此行为，该调用可在其自身首选构造函数确定之前或之后进行。

items.source: See registerExternallyManagedInitMethod(String) for details regarding the format for the supplied initMethod.
items.translation: 有关提供的 `initMethod` 的格式详情，请参阅registerExternallyManagedInitMethod(String)。

items.source: See registerExternallyManagedDestroyMethod(String) for details regarding the format for the supplied destroyMethod.
items.translation: 有关提供的 `destroyMethod` 的格式详情，请参阅registerExternallyManagedDestroyMethod(String)。

items.source: Note: The preferred choice for bean definitions derived from declarative sources (for example, XML definitions) is the flexible GenericBeanDefinition variant. GenericBeanDefinition comes with the advantage that it allows for dynamically defining parent dependencies, not 'hard-coding' the role as a root bean definition, even supporting parent relationship changes in the bean post-processor phase.
items.translation: 注意：对于源自声明式源（例如 XML 定义）的 Bean 定义，首选的选项是灵活的GenericBeanDefinition变体。GenericBeanDefinition 的优势在于它允许动态定义父级依赖关系，而不是将角色“硬编码”为根 Bean 定义，甚至支持在 Bean 后置处理器阶段更改父级关系。

items.source: See registerExternallyManagedInitMethod(String) for details regarding the format for the initialization methods in the returned set.
items.translation: 有关返回集合中初始化方法的格式详情，请参阅registerExternallyManagedInitMethod(String)。

items.source: See registerExternallyManagedDestroyMethod(String) for details regarding the format for the destruction methods in the returned set.
items.translation: 有关返回集合中销毁方法的格式详情，请参阅registerExternallyManagedDestroyMethod(String)。

items.source: Specify the AnnotatedElement defining qualifiers, to be used instead of the target class or factory method.
items.translation: 指定定义限定符的 AnnotatedElement，以替代目标类或工厂方法。

items.source: Return the AnnotatedElement defining qualifiers, if any. Otherwise, the factory method and target class will be checked.
items.translation: 返回定义限定符（如有）的 AnnotatedElement。否则，将检查工厂方法和目标类。
